subject: Novaretail evaluation — kickoff, cadence, and acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novaretail.com>, Jake Miller <jake.miller@novaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novaretail evaluation — kickoff, cadence, and acceptance criteria

Elena / Jake — thanks for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum.

Call takeaways (short):
- Goal: validate Redwood can reduce average search-relevant token cost by 30% while keeping relevance >= current baseline (CTR on search results) for the test catalog.
- Scope: 2-week evaluation on a subset (50k SKUs), traffic shadowed from production, Redwood-hosted trial instance with dedicated model variant.
- Key success metrics: relevance delta (CTR/NRR), per-request latency p95 <= 350ms, and token cost/unit.

What we need from Novaretail before kickoff:
1) A sample dataset (CSV or JSONL) for the 50k SKU slice (fields and sample rows) — ideally anonymized.
2) API access to a shadowing endpoint or a way to replay 48 hours of search logs.
3) Primary owner for product/infra (name & contact).

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (next week): kickoff + data ingestion validation (1 hour)
- Week 1: config/tuning + run A/B shadow tests
- Week 2: final readout + decision meeting (deliverables: scorecard, cost breakdown, recommended next steps)

Cadence: weekly check-ins (Wednesdays 11am PT) + ad-hoc syncs as needed. Can you confirm availability for kickoff the week of July 5th? If that works, we’ll send calendar invites, an eval plan (attached), and a short onboarding checklist.

Attached: novaretail-eval-plan.xlsx (high level tasks + owners). I also included a sample data-schema JSON for fields we typically use.

Next steps (my asks):
- Elena: confirm kickoff week and point person for data access
- Jake: confirm whether legal needs to review a short trial DPA/terms before we spin up a dedicated instance
- Marissa / Priyom: once Elena confirms, can you own the kickoff agenda and telemetry checklist?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novaretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Miller <jake.miller@novaretail.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Novaretail evaluation — kickoff, cadence, and acceptance criteria

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers:
- Kickoff: week of July 5th works for our product owner (Tues/Thu mornings best).
- Data: we can share an anonymized 50k SKU JSONL export by end of day Tuesday (will include product title, category, and historic CTR).
- Legal: Jake said they’ll review the short-term trial terms; he’ll loop Legal if anything looks non-standard.

A few clarifications from our side:
- Acceptance metric: our internal PM wants a sample scoring rubric — e.g., +X% CTR improvement on search sessions where Redwood is used vs baseline AND no more than Y% of queries with relevance drop > Z. We can give you examples.
- Environment: we prefer Redwood to run the trial on a dedicated cloud instance (isolated) — can you confirm instance sizing and if we need to provide any keys?

I’ll wait for the kickoff invite and the onboarding checklist. Thanks — excited to see the baseline comparison.

Best,
Elena
Director, Search & Discovery | Novaretail

Subject: Re: Novaretail evaluation — kickoff, cadence, and acceptance criteria

Karthik / Elena — great, thanks for confirming the week. A few operational notes from Redwood Ops / Success so the kickoff has clear owners and we don’t block on small items: 

Operational checklist (I’ll own items in bold):
- Kickoff agenda + invite (owner: Marissa) — include stakeholders: product, infra, legal (if needed), CS eng
- Data validation steps (owner: Priyom) — schema check, sample ingestion run, mapping notes
- Telemetry and scoring (owner: Marissa) — we’ll provide a template scorecard with CTR/NRR delta, latency distribution, and token cost per request
- Trial instance sizing (owner: Infra lead) — preliminary rec: g4dn.xlarge-equivalent; we can adjust after sample ingestion
- Canary gating rules (owner: Priyom) — suggested: if relevance drop > 3% on top-10 results for more than 1% of queries, auto-fallback to baseline; same for latency breach at p95 > 450ms

Elena — we’ll attach the scorecard template before kickoff. For the dedicated instance: Redwood will provision and share a temporary API key; we only need a network allowlist from Novaretail if you want IP-restricted access.

I’ve sketched a short kickoff agenda (30 min): intros, success metrics, data ingestion plan, telemetry & sample run, immediate blockers, and finalize calendar for weekly checks.

- Deliverables we’ll bring to kickoff: onboarding checklist, scorecard template, ephemeral API key process, and a short SOW stub.
- Attachments: novaretail-eval-plan.xlsx, sample-docs/data-schema.json (see attachments in this thread).
